beats.say: 2 blue cubes and 3 orange cubes make one group. The ratio is 2 to 3: for every 2 blue, there are 3 orange.
Add another group. Now there are 4 blue and 6 orange, still 2 to 3.
Three groups: 6 blue and 9 orange. However many groups, every group has 2 blue and 3 orange.
Share 35 sweets in the ratio 2 to 3.
Each group takes 2 + 3 = 5 sweets. 35 divided by 5 = 7 groups, so one part is 7.
Blue gets 2 parts: 2 times 7 = 14. Orange gets 3 parts: 3 times 7 = 21.
As a bar: 5 equal parts of 7. 14 + 21 = 35, so nothing is left over.
